authentication: Anonymous HTTP requests with no Authorization header or cookie jar; repository page shows Sign in.
scope: Public repository page, default-branch commit and full downloadable archive; README, code, sources, wiki and all evidence files are accessible without sign-in. This record is committed after checking that preceding content revision.
comparison_method: Recomputed Git blob content IDs from every anonymous archive file and compared them with the clean local Git index at the verified commit.
current_visibility_note: The user subsequently requested PRIVATE visibility. This old HTTP200 receipt does not establish current signed-out access.
